subject: Crestline renewal: private-offer request and split billing approach
messages:
From: Sophie Tu <sophie.tu@crestline.com>
To: naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal coming up - interested in private offer + capacity increase

Hi Naomi / Marissa,

Our annual Redwood contract with the AWS Marketplace is up for renewal in mid-July. Weve been very happy with the performance but would like to discuss two things before we lock the renewal:

- Annualizing the commitment via an AWS private offer (Budget team prefers consolidated billing)
- Increasing committed capacity from 500k tokens/month to 1M tokens/month for Q4 usage spikes

Can you share a recommended cadence (12 vs 18 month) and whether we can stagger billing (split the committed invoice into two invoices across quarters) to align with our fiscal flows? Also, looped in is our procurement lead Daniel for PO logistics.

Thanks,
Sophie
Sophie Tu
Head of Data Platforms, Crestline Analytics
Sophie.Tu@crestline.com

Attachment: none
From: naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Tu <sophie.tu@crestline.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, rafael_mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal coming up - interested in private offer + capacity increase

Hi Sophie — thanks for the clear ask. Quick summary of options and next steps below:

1) Term & pricing options
   - 12-month annualized private offer (standard uplift) — fastest to close, simplifies year-over-year budgeting.
   - 18-month with a small monthly discount — gives you price stability and spreads the amortization.

2) Capacity
   - We can bump the committed tokens to 1M/month and include a 10% buffer for burst credits.

3) Billing cadence
   - AWS private offers typically invoice on a single invoice, but we can structure a staggered acceptance: split the total committed dollars into two invoices (Q1 & Q3) via our finance agreement with Marketplace. This requires explicit PO lines and acceptance timeline from Crestline procurement.

Next steps I propose: Ill attach a short private-offer proposal (preliminary numbers) and Jonas will outline the Marketplace conversion steps. Rafael can confirm invoicing limitations. If Procurement (Daniel) can send the PO template or EDI requirements well incorporate them into the DocuSign flow.

Attaching: Redwood_Private_Offer_Proposal.pdf (proposal & pricing grid)

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Attachment: Redwood_Private_Offer_Proposal.pdf
From: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@crestline.com>
To: naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Tu <sophie.tu@crestline.com>, aws-marketplace-support@amazon.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal coming up - interested in private offer + capacity increase

Hi Naomi / Marissa,

Thanks — procurement here. A few details we need to proceed with a private offer and split billing:

- Legal entity for the contract: Crestline Analytics, Inc.
- PO format: PDF with line-item detail; we can attach a PO to the invoice.
- EDI/PO ingestion: our AP system accepts cXML and invoice-to-PO matching.
- Desired cadence: two invoices per year (July and January) if you can present the acceptance schedule.

Ive attached our PO template (Crestline_PO_2026.pdf). Please confirm Redwoods billing remittance details and whether AWS Marketplace will accept the staggered acceptance flow. Also confirm any required marketplace account IDs so we can include them on the PO.

Regards,
Daniel Cho
Procurement Manager, Crestline Analytics
Attachment: Crestline_PO_2026.pdf
From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@crestline.com>, naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, aws-marketplace-support@amazon.com, rafael_mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal coming up - interested in private offer + capacity increase

Hi Daniel — looping in marketplace steps. Short answers:

- AWS private offers can be configured to accept acceptance windows; well create a private offer in the Marketplace and attach the DocuSign acceptance to it.
- Staggered billing: Marketplace will create a single commitment, but Redwood Finance can issue multiple invoices post-acceptance if the private offer includes those billing instructions. Well need the PO line items and the Crestline Marketplace account ID (AWS Seller account ID on PO).

Ive included an operational guide (AWS_Private_Offer_Guide.pdf) in case your AP team wants the spec. Proposed timeline:
- Wed 7/1: Crestline returns completed PO (with Marketplace account ID)
- Thu 7/2: Redwood issues private offer and DocuSign packet
- Mon 7/6: Target signing and acceptance

DocuSign link (proposal & acceptance): https://www.docusign.com/transaction/ABC-DEF-2026

Let me know if you need a direct vendor contact at AWS Marketplace; I can pull them in.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Marketplace Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Attachment: AWS_Private_Offer_Guide.pdf
From: rafael_mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Renewal coming up - interested in private offer + capacity increase

Hi all,

Finance notes on invoicing: we can support two invoices per year, but we need the following stated on the PO: total committed amount, invoice split schedule (percent or $ amounts), and billing contact for remittance. Also confirm tax treatment and whether Crestline requires a VAT/GST field (for non-US entities).

If you prefer, we can provide a one-page invoicing addendum to attach to the PO; happy to draft once Crestline confirms the split (e.g., 60%/40% or fixed dollar split).

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com

- Crestline to return signed PO using the attached Crestline_PO_2026.pdf with AWS Seller ID included on line item.
- Well prepare the private offer for a 12-month term with committed 1,000,000 tokens/month + 10% burst buffer.
- Invoicing split: Redwood to issue two invoices per year; Rafael will draft a one-page invoicing addendum once Crestline confirms the split.
- DocuSign link for acceptance (Jonas): https://www.docusign.com/transaction/ABC-DEF-2026
